topic: Data aggregation bug in session reporting
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a data discrepancy found where the hourly report showed higher values for a given day than the daily report. This bug affects users whose data was reaggregated using templates after October 3rd, specifically when a prediction exists in the model for an hour but no sessions are recorded.

The base frequency calculation relies on sessions, dwell time, and cluster frequency. When a predictive model is unavailable, the system defaults to calculating frequency by multiplying the count of sessions by a factor (defaulting to 3).
action_items: Investigate data discrepancy related to hourly vs. daily aggregation for specific dates.
